configuration.title: {testWright}
description: A {product} bots test workbench for VS Code: discover the bots of a {product} project, build run plans with drag and drop, run them against the {product} engine, and review {product} and Allure reports.
viewsWelcome.g4TestWrightLauncher.0.cont:
Discover the bots of your {product} project, build a run plan, and run it against the {product} engine.
[Open Test Wright](command:TestWright.OpenNew)
Each click opens another Test Wright tab, so you can work on several plans at once. Each file under bots/ is a test and each subfolder is a suite. Runs are saved under reports/ with {product} and Allure reports.
New to Test Wright? Add a few practice bots to this project and follow the learning path.
[Add Practice Bots](command:TestWright.AddPracticeBots)
